notes.notes:
Happy New Year, everyone!
Thank you very much for playing “The Little Witch and The Lost Memories” over the past year.

As we head into 2025, we will continue developing new titles while also improving and updating this game. If you have any feedback or thoughts about your play experience, we’d be delighted if you could share them in the Reviews section. Your feedback is invaluable for our future development.

notes.title: Title Change for Japanese Version & Demo Playable Range Expansion
notes.notes:
[h2][h1]Title Change for the Japanese Version[/h1][/h2]
We have changed the title of the Japanese version of "The Little Witch and The Lost Memories" to "ちいさな魔女と失くした記憶."
Through this title change, we hope more players will be able to experience the charm of the story.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840621/b746a8819f426086e01f0b58fef4734118a98e74.png[/img]


In addition, the logo for the Chinese version has also been updated to reflect this change.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840621/9818894ac153395138f99481a1a317636bc01526.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840621/9ac292c9be7f16f0b0d52660b59f9e528b0cb567.png[/img]


[h2]Demo Playable Range Expanded[/h2]
Now you can play up to the end of Chapter 2 in the demo. The full game is composed of three main chapters and a short final chapter. With the demo covering the game's midpoint, it's a perfect opportunity to immerse yourself in the story and get a feel for the adventure ahead.
Additionally, progress in the demo will be synced with the full version, so after playing up to the middle in the demo, you can purchase the full version and continue where you left off.

notes.title: Update v1.1.0
notes.notes:
[b]1.1.0 Update [/b]

[h2]Your guide in-game now has more advice to give you, so you don’t get lost[/h2]
The game’s narrative experience is our main focus in this game. For this reason, we have added a great deal of guide dialogue so that the player does not get lost in ‘where’ and ‘what’ to do when solving the game’s puzzles.

[h2]Improved puzzle-solving mechanics[/h2]
We improved several puzzle-solving mechanics and fixed some game behavior that could have added unnecessary trouble to the puzzles.

[h2]Some game graphics in the game have been updated[/h2]
We will continue to update the game graphics to make them even more beautiful and cute.

notes.title: Guidelines for Game streaming and Fanfic
notes.notes:
Guidelines for Livestreaming and Fanfic of "The Little Witch and The Lost Memories"

[h1]Game Streaming Guidelines[/h1]

[h2]Introduction[/h2]
We're thrilled that you're playing our games and want to stream or post videos about them. By following these guidelines, we hope you'll be able to share amazing experiences with your viewers.

[h2]Requests for Live Streaming and Video Posting[/h2]
Please check the following when doing live streams or posting videos:

[h3]Who Can Stream or Post Videos[/h3]
Anyone, whether a company or an individual, can use our studio's games for live streaming or video posts.

[h3]About Making Money[/h3]
You can earn money from live streams or videos using our studio's games, but please remember to include a link to the Steam store page.

[h3]How to Include the Steam Store URL[/h3]
For platforms with a description box (like YouTube): Put the Steam store URL in the description.
For platforms without a description box (like Twitch): Pin the store URL in the comments.

[h3]Stream Title[/h3]
Always include "Spoilers Ahead" in your stream title.

[h2]Prohibited Actions[/h2]

[h3]Audio-Only Posts[/h3]
Posting isolated audio content (voices, music, sound effects) from our games is not permitted.

[h3]Illegal or Inappropriate Content[/h3]
Using our game content to create posts that violate laws or social norms is prohibited.

[h3]Privacy Violations and Defamation[/h3]
Do not use our game content to invade privacy or defame others, including our studio.

[h3]Cheating and Exploitation[/h3]
Posts featuring gameplay using cheats, unauthorized access, modifications, or other prohibited methods are not allowed.

[h3]Intellectual Property Infringement[/h3]
Do not use our game content in ways that infringe upon third-party intellectual property rights.

[h3]Violent or Discriminatory Content[/h3]
Posts containing violent, discriminatory, or hate speech content using our game material are prohibited.

[h3]Unrelated Advertising[/h3]
Using our game content to promote unrelated products or services is not allowed.

[h3]Non-Gameplay Commercial Use[/h3]
Commercial use of game footage or content unrelated to gameplay demonstration is prohibited.

[h3]Misinformation[/h3]
Spreading false or misleading information about our games or studio is not permitted.



[h1]Studio Asahi Fanfic Guidelines[/h1]
We're truly grateful to all the fans who love Studio Asahi's works. 
To support your creative activities and ensure everyone has a great time with fanfiction, we've put together some guidelines. Please take a moment to look them over before you start creating.

[h2]Hashtags[/h2]
For posts related to "The Little Witch and The Lost Memories," please use the hashtag #LaoiseKawaii.

[h2]Prohibited Content[/h2]
We kindly ask that you don't include the following in your fanfic:

- Content that damages the world view of Studio Asahi's works
- Violent or grotesque content, or sensitive content that includes sexual depictions
- Content that strongly pushes political, religious, or ideological views
- Anything that could upset or harm others
- Content that infringes on the rights of third parties
- Content that includes spoilers of key story elements

[h2]Commercial Use[/h2]
The creation of fanfiction is only permitted if it is not intended for commercial purposes.
However, we allow commercialized fanfiction under the following conditions:

- The creator must have played the game
- The work is digital (e.g., creating illustrations upon request)
- You use our official hashtag when sharing

We encourage you to follow these guidelines and enjoy making your fanfic with peace of mind. Happy creating!

notes.title: 2024/08/02 Update v1.0.3
notes.notes:
[b]v1.0.3[/b]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would freeze in Chapter 3, Episode 3 when played with certain screen settings.
[*] Fixed a problem where opening the menu at a specific timing could cause the game to freeze without stopping the conversation.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 2, Episode 2 where the duvet could be reacquired after finishing bed-making.
[/list]

This week, we prioritized addressing issues related to gameplay. We apologize for any inconvenience caused to players who experienced disruptions in their game progression.

We are planning to update the guide in the future. While there are no issues in progressing through the story with the current content, players may have varying experiences with the difficulty of the puzzles depending on their individual skills.

Therefore, we are considering how to enhance the guide while maintaining the enjoyment of the puzzle-solving aspect of the game and providing assistance to players who might get stuck. For example, we might implement phased conversations in the guide, allowing players to progress through the story without getting stuck on puzzles. However, creating these phased conversations may take some time.

We will continue to update the game to ensure a comfortable playing experience. Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

notes.title: We Want to Hear from You: Your Feedback Matters!
notes.notes:
Dear players, your feedback is crucial for improving our games. We'd love to hear your thoughts on our current releases and use your insights to enhance our current and future creations. Here are a few key areas where your input can make a real difference:

[b]Usability and Controls[/b]
Our dev team interacts with the game daily, so we might miss some usability issues. If you have suggestions of any kind to improve the controls or UI, please let us know! We aim to create a more intuitive and comfortable gaming experience based on your suggestions.

[b]Puzzle Challenges[/b]
In "The Little Witch and The Lost Memories," we've included a guide character to help you along. However, if you still found certain parts difficult, don't hesitate to tell us. We prioritize the story experience and don't want puzzles to hinder your enjoyment. Point out any tricky spots, and we'll add more guiding information to keep your adventure flowing smoothly.

We're also eager to hear your general thoughts and suggestions for improving the game as a whole.

How to Reach Us:
Your feedback is invaluable. Here's how you can share your thoughts:

[b]Steam Community and Reviews[/b]: Drop your comments in the Steam community or leave a review. Your opinions are important guidelines for our future improvements.

[b]Discord[/b]: Join the conversation on our Discord server. We've got a dedicated feedback channel, or you can DM the Studio Asahi account directly.
Join our server here: [url=https://discord.gg/bVNwx5edXF]https://discord.gg/bVNwx5edXF[/url]

[b]Google Forms[/b]: For more detailed suggestions, our Studio Asahi contact form is ready and waiting. We appreciate comprehensive opinions and proposals.
Find it here: [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeSghnZyTnxBVV5E8xQVJx-Bi6SoXreiK2z9XRwqd08I_4ozQ/viewform]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeSghnZyTnxBVV5E8xQVJx-Bi6SoXreiK2z9XRwqd08I_4ozQ/viewform[/url]

We look forward to your cooperation and can't wait to hear from you!

notes.title: Studio Asahi's debut game, "The Little Witch and the Lost Memories" is out now!
notes.notes:
Dive into this captivating puzzle adventure game where you'll guide Laoise, a young little witch who's lost her memories, through a her dreams to regain her memories. Explore dreams and solve various puzzles in this story-rich adventure as you uncover 10 memories from Laoise's past. 
With an estimated playtime of 5 hours (varies based on your puzzle-solving prowess), you'll be transported into a world of charming pixel art so don't forget to share your thoughts in a review!

As for our future plans, we are planning a detailed graphics update for the game. We will continue our efforts to deliver even more beautiful visuals based on the feedback we will receive after the release. 

Additionally, we are planning to produce casual spin-off games featuring Laoise and the other characters from "The Little Witch and the Lost Memories". This is just the beginning of Laoise's tale, and we're committed to bringing you many more enchanting stories to look forward to.


We will also keep you updated via Discord. We look forward to your participation! Let's create a fun and engaging community together.
Click here to join our Discord server : [url=https://discord.gg/bVNwx5edXF]https://discord.gg/bVNwx5edXF[/url]

notes.title: Information on The Little Witch and the Lost Memories, Studio Asahi's first game
notes.notes:
Hello! We are Studio Asahi, a new indie game studio that started late last year.
From our office in Yokohama, we aim to allow people from all over the world to experience our stories. 

We plan to start this journey with our first game, "The Little Witch and the Lost Memories"

In this game, you will play as a girl called Laoise who lost her memories. To get them back, you must journey onto her dream world, where you will discover secrets along the way that can help you regain those memories. 

At it's core, The Little Witch and the Lost Memories is a point-and-click puzzle game where you look for secrets and clues in RPG-styled rooms. Coupling this experience with refined pixel art and sound design, we hope to deliver an enjoyable and fun experience. 

Asides from our Steam community, we also post updates on the game's development on different social media sites. Please give us a follow!
